sentences.en: The truth of the story is familiar to you all.
sentences.zh: 这个故事的真相对你们大家都很熟悉。

sentences.en: My cousin was familiar with trouble when he was young.
sentences.zh: 我表弟年轻时就经常遇到麻烦。

sentences.en: It was natural for him to be familiar with jazz.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，熟悉爵士乐是理所当然的事。

senses.zh: 常客，密友；高级官吏的家属；天主教皇主教的仆人
